plan.script:
# NAHLED migrace VLAN - vygenerovano controllerem, NESPOUSTET bez kontroly
# Doporuceni: provadet z konzole/MAC-Winboxu, ne pres sit, ktera se prave meni.
{
/interface bridge port set [find interface="ether1"] bridge="bridge" pvid=1
/interface bridge port set [find interface="ether2"] bridge="bridge" pvid=1
/interface bridge port set [find interface="ether3"] bridge="bridge" pvid=10
/interface bridge port set [find interface="ether4"] bridge="bridge" pvid=20
/interface bridge vlan add bridge="bridge" vlan-ids=10 tagged="bridge,ether1" untagged="ether3" comment="mtc: migrace VLAN"
/interface bridge vlan add bridge="bridge" vlan-ids=20 tagged="bridge,ether1" untagged="ether4" comment="mtc: migrace VLAN"
/interface vlan add name="vlan10" interface="bridge" vlan-id=10 comment="mtc: migrace VLAN"
/ip address set [find address="10.0.10.1/24" interface="br-vlan10"] interface="vlan10"
/ip dhcp-server set [find name="dhcp-v10"] interface="vlan10"
/interface vlan add name="vlan20" interface="bridge" vlan-id=20 comment="mtc: migrace VLAN"
/interface bridge port remove [find interface="vlan10-e1"]
/interface vlan remove [find name="vlan10-e1"]
/interface bridge port remove [find interface="vlan20-e1"]
/interface vlan remove [find name="vlan20-e1"]
/interface bridge remove [find name="br-vlan10"]
/interface bridge remove [find name="br-vlan20"]
/interface bridge set [find name="bridge"] vlan-filtering=yes
}
